dimensions.definition_quote: The Form facet describes transformations applied to a text after an initial version already exists.
value_list_verbatim: F4: global rhetorical or structural restructuring.
dimensions.quote: For this reason, the Form facet is defined as a scale of increasing textual transformation.

dimensions.definition_quote: The Generation facet describes how a text segment came into existence.
value_list_verbatim: G2: AI-generated with a simple prompt.
G3: AI-generated with a detailed prompt.
G5: AI-generated through a structured multi-step conversational or computational pipeline.
dimensions.quote: The Generation facet refines that space for text production.

dimensions.definition_quote: The Evaluation facet describes how the resulting text was reviewed, checked, or validated.
dimensions.quote: It is separate from Generation because the reliability of a text is not determined only by how it was produced.

dimensions.definition_quote: The Intent facet describes why AI was used.
value_list_verbatim: I0: no AI intent or unspecified use.
I3: generation of new textual content.
I4: conceptual support, ideation, framing, or argument development.
dimensions.quote: This facet is necessary because the same technical interaction may serve very different scholarly functions.

dimensions.definition_quote: The Control facet describes who directed the production process.
value_list_verbatim: C1: AI used under narrow constraints.
C3: AI-dominant production with human selection or approval.
dimensions.quote: Control describes agency, constraint, and decision authority.

dimensions.definition_quote: The Traceability facet describes whether the production process can be reconstructed.
value_list_verbatim: T3: full logs, model identification, and intermediate versions available.
dimensions.quote: It concerns prompts, logs, model identifiers, intermediate versions, metadata, and external verification.

schemes.scheme_name_verbatim: Four linguistic dimensions extracted from the plain language guidance.

dimensions.definition_quote: Use everyday words and simple expressions.
dimensions.quote: none of the AITS received a point for Simple Words and Expressions.

dimensions.definition_quote: Avoidance of jargon; appropriate use of shortened forms, with explanation.
dimensions.quote: Performance on Jargon and Shortened-Form is similarly weak: only 5% of AITS score positively on this dimension.

dimensions.definition_quote: Appropriate use of we, you, and your to address readers directly.
dimensions.quote: more than half of the AITSs (52%) appropriately use Personal Pronouns to directly engage the readers.

dimensions.definition_quote: Respectful and inclusive wording acknowledging diverse individuals and backgrounds.
dimensions.quote: 100% of the AITS satisfyingly follow the guidance for Inclusive Language .
